newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sanmao Railway eyes 200 mln B share IPO in July.
newsitem.headline: Sanmao Railway eyes 200 mln B share IPO in July.

text.p: Guangdong Sanmao Railway Co Ltd plans to make an initial public offering of 200 million B shares in July for listing on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.

The offer will carry a P/E ratio of more than eight based on the firm's forecasts for per-share earnings in 1997, he told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin. Profit figures will not be released until an audit is completed.

Sanmao has appointed China Southern Securities Co as one of two main domestic underwriters for the offer, which has yet to be approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, he said. He declined to name the other domestic underwriter or the global coordinator.

Sanmao, based in Guangzhou, capital of southern Guangdong province, plans to use most of the proceeds to renovate its 357-km railway linking the cities of Sanshui and Maoming in Guangdong, the official said.
Remaining funds will be used to repay bank loans, he added.

Sanmao has 800 million outstanding shares -- 330 million held by the Guangdong provincial government, 270 million shares by the Ministry of Railways, 160 million shares by Three-Rich Investment Ltd and 40 million shares by other institutions.
